name: A Strange Red Key
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: The small red key seems to be made of some kind of bone material. It is heavy in your hand, but appears very fragile. Why would a member of the Shadow Council have such a thing? Perhaps there is something within Jaedenar that this strange key unlocks.
narrative.objectives: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.
narrative.offerRewardText: The key, you've found it! Please, give it to me and I can finally escape!
narrative.requestItemsText:
I begin to wonder if I'll ever escape this cage.

It's only a matter of time before they sacrifice me to whatever demons they worship. The monsters!

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 55 to 57, 23,350 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Red Key
quests.objectiveText: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

quests.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
quests.objectiveText: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold.

quests.name: Retribution of the Light
quests.objectiveText: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

quests.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
quests.objectiveText: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
